messages.content: You can call search_flights to find flights matching the user's needs.
Find me a direct flight from Beijing to San Francisco next Monday, economy class, under $1500.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to find a direct flight from Beijing (PEK) to San Francisco (SFO) next Monday, economy class, under $15,000. I need to figure out what "next Monday" means - since today is not specified, I'll assume they mean the upcoming Monday. Let me use the current date of January 19, 2025, which is a Sunday, so next Monday would be January 20, 2025.

Let me search for flights with these criteria:
- from_airport: PEK (Beijing Capital International Airport)
- to_airport: SFO (San Francisco International Airport)
- depart_date: 2025-01-20
- cabin_class: economy
- direct_only: true
- max_price_usd: 15000
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="search_flights">
<parameter name="from_airport">PEK</parameter>
<parameter name="to_airport">SFO</parameter>
<parameter name="depart_date">2025-01-20</parameter>
<parameter name="max_price_usa">15000</parameter>
<parameter name="cabin_class">economy</parameter>
<parameter name="direct_only">true</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
